<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 10"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Spell Swallow](/Feats.aspx?ID=5460) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 71

**Archetype** [Ostilli Host](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=222)

**Prerequisites**
[Ostilli Host Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5451)

</column>

---

Your ostilli has grown strong enough to completely consume a spell cast at you, granting you the Devour Ambient Magic action.

 **Devour Ambient Magic** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** A creature Casts a Spell with you as the only target; **Effect** Your ostilli radiates cyan light as its tentacle-like filters attempt to consume the magical effect. You can attempt to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) the triggering spell with an [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35) or [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43) check and a counteract rank equal to half your level.
name: Spell Swallow
